title: pinaropappus roseus
intro: Pinaropappus roseus, commonly known as the Rose Mallow, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Pinaropappus roseus include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Pinaropappus roseus are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Pinaropappus roseus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
